text: Machine learning models identify useful patterns from examples and use those patterns to make predictions.
Transformers process sequences using attention instead of relying only on recurrent computation.
A language model generates text by predicting the next token based on previous tokens.
RAG systems retrieve relevant external information before generating an answer.
Fine-tuning is useful when a pretrained model needs to adapt to a specialized domain.
Embeddings are numerical representations that capture semantic relationships between text items.
AI agents can use tools to interact with external systems and complete multi-step tasks.
Quantization can make language models easier to deploy on devices with limited memory.
